snippet.title: Rally-X - SG-1000 Gameplay
snippet.description:
Played on Xbox Game Bar
Played on RetroArch (Genesis Plus GX)

Rally X on SG-1000 is an unlicensed Taiwanese port of the MSX port. That might explain why the music is messed up in this version.
